citation: Korecha, D., and A. Sorteberg (2013), Validation of operational seasonal rainfall forecast in Ethiopia, Water Resources Research, 49(11), 7681-7697, doi:10.1002/2013WR013760 (figure: homogeneous rainfall regions currently used for the preparation of seasonal rainfall forecast in Ethiopia).
license_note: Publisher's terms (Wiley); the figure is not redistributed. Only the digitized region grid derived from it is stored and published, with this citation.
created_by: Template prepared by the assistant (Claude) from the figure supplied by the project team; regions computed by scripts/digitize_rainfall_regions.py.
checks_for_reviewer: The digitized regions (QC figure) follow the thick boundaries of the source figure for all eight regions I-VIII.
The strip along the southern border (about 36-40 deg E, 4-5 deg N) has no separating line in the source and is assigned to region VIII.
Region numbers match the EMI Bega 2026/27 zone labels: III Southwest, VI South Highland, VII South, VIII South-Southeast lowlands (each EMI arrow tip falls in the region of the same number).
The region layout is the one published in 2013; using it for the 2026/27 zones assumes EMI still uses these regions.
